channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dion Waiters | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dion Waiters from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dion Waiters
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on if Dion Waiters could still play in this series:

“I think it's still possible. He's still day-to-day. We'll figure out how he continues to respond to treatment.”

Frank Vogel on Dion Waiters, Sep 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Dion Waiters
item.description:
Udonis Haslem on Dion Waiters suspension:

“A statement has been made by the organization, so that's what it is. As far as health wise, I'm just glad my guy is OK.”

Udonis Haslem on Dion Waiters, Nov 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Dion Waiters
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Udonis Haslem on Dion Waiters:

“Dion’s our brother. Hope he gets back as soon as possible. I love Dion.”

Udonis Haslem on Dion Waiters, Oct 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Pat Riley on James Johnson, Dion Waiters
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Riley on Dion Waiters and James Johnson:

“Both of them, we need more from them. We need them to be in the best shape in training camp and with the best health.”

Pat Riley on James Johnson, Dion Waiters, Jun 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on James Johnson, Dion Waiters
item.description:
Spoelstra on James Johnson and Dion Waiters:

“They’re able to both do a lot more. So, I’m encouraged by it. There’s not a timetable on either one of them. But as long as they’re making progress, we’re good.”

Erik Spoelstra on James Johnson, Dion Waiters, Oct 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Dion Waiters
item.description:
“I own some property on Waiters Island. It’s just me and him that live there. He knows what it is. We both know.”

Kevin Durant on Dion Waiters, Dec 4, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dion Waiters
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Spoelstra on Dion Waiters being left back in Miami:

“He's getting great work there. So at this point, just want to keep him on track.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dion Waiters, Mar 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dion Waiters
item.description:
#Heat coachErik Spoelstra:

“What I notice the most about Dion (Waiters) is his every-day commitment.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dion Waiters, Mar 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Dion Waiters
item.description:
#Heat PGGoran Dragic on Dion Waiters:

“He was unbelievable. It's always tempting against your former team. We tried to keep feeding him.”

Goran Dragic on Dion Waiters, Mar 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Dion Waiters
item.description:
Tim Cato:Kevin Durant on Dion Waiters:

“He can have tough games and he still thinks he's the best player in the world.”

Kevin Durant on Dion Waiters, May 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @tim_cato.

item.title: Sam Presti on Dion Waiters
item.description:
“Dion Waiters is a player that we’ve tracked and liked since his time at Syracuse, in the NBA, and with USA Basketball. Dion provides another proven scorer that positively impacts our roster and adds depth and flexibility,”

Sam Presti on Dion Waiters, Jan 5, 2015. Source: NBA.com.
